name: Seikitokyu Kogyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Seikitokyu Kogyo Co., Ltd. operates as an infrastructure building company in Japan. The company is involved in paving various roads, such as expressways and bridges. It also undertakes civil engineering, and environment and landscape projects; and manufactures and sells asphalt mixtures. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
